scope: Targeted primary-source review of five candidate directions; not an exhaustive novelty certification.
source_access_notes: Hugging Face markdown/API fetches for 2610.07834 returned tool fetch errors; primary arXiv HTML was used.
The first ADAPT-Z HTML URL used an unavailable v3; primary metadata establishes v2.
Pinned GitHub tree URLs failed through web fetch; GitHub connector succeeded.

sources.title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Refreshing Memory for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
sources.read: Abstract, method Sections 3.1-3.6, theoretical statement, comparison and causal-admissibility passages
sources.finding: Frozen forecasting, continually refreshed memory, learned relational weighting and validation-calibrated correction are already combined. Whole future windows must be observed before retrieval.
sources.implication: The earlier upgrade sketch cannot support novelty by those components alone. Coordinate-wise asynchronous visibility remains a comparison question, not an established new invention.

sources.title: Stationarity-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting
sources.read: Abstract, retrieval description and Appendix E limitations
sources.finding: Retrieval relevance, diversity and aggregation already account for stationarity. The authors identify global similarity, dense-window storage and dataset-level stationarity as limitations.
sources.implication: Learned retention, diversity or drift awareness alone do not justify a new FIM claim. Any localized policy must beat this family under equal information and storage.

sources.title: EPOC: Endpoint-Preserving Online Correction With Compressed Residual State for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
sources.read: Primary abstract and full-text structure; targeted method review required before implementation
sources.finding: A close comparator for online correction from compressed residual state.
sources.implication: Spatial or temporal residual compression is not sufficient novelty. Exact estimator and state/cost equivalence require a closer implementation comparison.

sources.title: Channel-wise Retrieval for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
sources.finding: Per-channel retrieval with graph pruning and spectral ranking addresses heterogeneous channel dynamics.
sources.implication: Channel-specific retrieval must be compared with this method. CRAFT is an ambiguous acronym; this is the Kang et al. method, not unrelated CRAFT papers.

sources.title: Online time series prediction using feature adjustment
sources.finding: ADAPT-Z adapts representations using current features and historical gradients under delayed multi-step feedback.
sources.implication: Delayed feedback and frozen-backbone adaptation are established comparison axes, not novelty by themselves.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Forecasting of Time-series
sources.read: Author repository README and linked paper metadata
sources.finding: Official implementation of a retrieval forecasting comparator; README specifies its original package versions.
sources.implication: Use an exact admitted revision and reproduce its recipe before reporting superiority; dependency declarations alone do not prove reproducibility.

sources.title: On the Benefits of Memory for Modeling Time-Dependent PDEs
sources.read: Primary abstract and full-text outline; original theory and architecture
sources.finding: MemNO combines temporal state-space modeling with Fourier operators and studies coarse/noisy PDE observations.
sources.implication: Memory benefit for partially observed PDEs is an occupied research problem. A current-state baseline alone is insufficient.

sources.title: HS-FNO: History-Space Fourier Neural Operator for Non-Markovian Partial Differential Equations
sources.read: Primary article and current project registry
sources.finding: A history-state neural operator is a relevant comparator for non-Markovian dynamics.
sources.implication: The successor needs actual temporal-history controls and compatible state semantics. Pinned source integration remains unadmitted.

sources.title: Learning Neural Operators from Partial Observations via Latent Autoregressive Modeling
sources.read: Primary abstract and local exact-version benchmark contract
sources.finding: LANO and POBench-PDE directly address partial observation, masked supervision and latent reconstruction.
sources.implication: Adding online target reveals changes the information contract unless the official task provides them. Any online extension must be separately named and shared by all controls.

sources.title: Nonparametric Regression With Missing Outcomes Using Weighted Kernel Estimating Equations
sources.read: Primary methods and stated missing-at-random assumptions
sources.finding: Inverse-probability and augmented inverse-probability weighted kernel estimators already address missing outcomes under stated assumptions.
sources.implication: Masked kernel residual estimation and propensity weighting need a precise distinction; they do not identify arbitrary outcome-dependent missingness automatically.

sources.title: OneNet supplemental delayed-feedback evaluation
sources.finding: Delayed feedback is explicitly evaluated in earlier online forecasting work.
sources.implication: A delayed-reveal experiment is useful but not itself a new setting.

sources.title: Battling the Non-stationarity in Time Series Forecasting via Test-time Adaptation
sources.read: Primary publisher abstract and primary arXiv introduction
sources.finding: TAFAS already uses partially observed targets and gated calibration for forecasting adaptation.
sources.implication: Partial feedback and a calibration gate are established ingredients; a new coordinate-level mechanism needs a material distinction.

sources.title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
sources.read: Primary abstract, Sections 1-4 and scope; external results not locally reproduced
sources.finding: Audits causal release delays in published adaptation methods and includes closed-form residual correctors. Partial-ground-truth prefixes are shortened for additional label lag.
sources.implication: A generic delayed-feedback correctness audit is also occupied. Candidate D requires a distinct scientific question about spatial missingness, not merely fixing timing.

sources.title: COSA: Context-aware Output-Space Adapter for Test-Time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting
sources.finding: A gated output-space adapter is updated on observed ground truth under a leakage-free protocol.
sources.implication: Frozen forecasting with gated residual adaptation is a comparator class.

sources.title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting
sources.read: Primary abstract only; full article is available but no detailed method review is claimed
sources.finding: Studies protocol cleanliness and adaptation using matured ground truth.
sources.implication: Causal maturity is an established evaluation requirement; detailed comparison remains required if this direction is pursued.

concepts.mechanism: Streaming residual retrieval plus a validation scalar gate
concepts.cause: Substantial mechanism overlap; correcting implementation is useful but does not create an architectural contribution.
concepts.falsifier: A reproduced existing method matches or exceeds the candidate at equal information/cost.

concepts.mechanism: Learned drift-aware addressing, diversity and retention
concepts.cause: The proposed mechanism is not yet mathematically distinct; predictive similarity and retention utility are unverified.
concepts.falsifier: Simple admitted retrieval or stationarity-aware controls match performance with fewer bytes or less compute.

concepts.mechanism: Compressed spatial residual memory with lightweight online correction
concepts.cause: Compression can erase relevant state; the difference from existing residual/state methods is not established.
concepts.falsifier: A direct history operator or residual ridge baseline matches the accuracy-cost frontier.

concepts.mechanism: Coordinate-level arrival-safe residual storage with mask-normalized retrieval and support-aware correction
concepts.cause: Visibility is necessary correctness. A comparative measurement contribution may be defensible, but novelty, selection assumptions, public data timing and matched baselines remain unresolved. A recent delay-aware audit further narrows the possible measurement contribution; partial feedback alone is not new.
concepts.falsifier: After fixing visibility and giving controls the same observations, the practical advantage disappears or a standard masked estimator matches it.

concepts.mechanism: Transport stored residual fields using physical geometry or symmetry before retrieval fusion
concepts.cause: No established transport operator, valid cross-geometry residual law, or bounded demonstration distinguishes this from existing operators.
concepts.falsifier: Transported residuals fail known-source reconstruction or no better than equally informed spatial interpolation/local regression.

checkpoint_1.reason: The central conceptual blockers are an unresolved material contribution beyond close prior work, insufficiently specified observation/selection assumptions, and no discriminating bounded study that isolates the proposed mechanism. Data and compute admission are additional downstream execution blockers, not substitutes for the contribution assessment.
